phase: Sectoral Financial Positions — Phase C F1/QSA semantics diagnostic
purpose: Diagnose the Phase B reconciliation failure without changing any promotion threshold, sector boundary, orientation, structural-zero rule or current reference-mode status.
diagnostic_questions: Does QSA publish resident F1 liabilities for S12, S121, S13, S11 or S1M despite the ESA structural interpretation used before Phase B?
Are F11 monetary gold and F12 SDR subcomponents published and do they reconcile to F1 for stock and flow?
Which F1 subcomponent accounts for the persistent stock residual observed in Phase B?
Does the 2021-Q3 flow discontinuity originate in F1/F11/F12 or in total-F series?
Do W1 F1 asset/liability entries correspond numerically to resident F1 positions/subcomponents in a way that clarifies counterpart orientation?
comparisons: For every address where F1/F11/F12 are all available, compute F1 - F11 - F12 by period.
Compare S121 F1 assets with W1 F1 asset/liability series by period without assuming which external entry is the counterpart.
Compare S121 F12 and W1 F12 entries to identify the SDR-related side empirically.
Compare S121 F11 and W1 F11 entries to identify the monetary-gold-related side empirically.
Report all F1/F11/F12 stock and flow values for 2021-Q2, 2021-Q3 and 2021-Q4.
Do not alter or exclude 2021-Q3; only classify whether a component discontinuity is visible.
exit_rule: Phase C ends with a retained semantic diagnosis or an explicit unresolved result. Any future Phase D promotion attempt requires a new preregistered contract written after Phase C is frozen, and Phase C observations may inform the scientific hypothesis but not retroactively alter Phase A/B pass thresholds.
